question: Select the incorrect form of the verb.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"struck"** means having hit or been hit. (मारा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The clock struck twelve, signaling the start of the new year.
 
 
 
• **"Strucken"** is an incorrect form of the verb "strike" and does not exist in standard English. (गलत रूप)
 
 
• **Example: **The correct form should be "struck" or "stricken" depending on the context.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the incorrect form of the verb** "strike"** is **"strucken".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Struck **(मारा हुआ): The **past tense of "strike"**.

 
 
• **Example:** He struck the ball with great force.
 
 
 
• **Strike **(मारना): To hit or attack someone or something forcefully.
 
 
• **Example: **The workers decided to go on **strike **for better wages.
 
 
 
• **Stricken** (पीड़ित): Affected by an undesirable condition or unpleasant feeling.
 
 
• **Example:** He was **stricken** with grief after hearing the news.
